where.zh: 草原與山丘關卡（1-1、1-2、1-4）、葉葉草原、巨菇森林、雪峰山
where.en: Meadow and hill courses (1-1, 1-2, 1-4), Leafy Meadow, Giant Mushroom Forest, Snowcap Mountain

where.zh: 天空關卡（1-3 雲橋、1-6 運動場）、霜峰雪原、天梯峰、鷹之巢、天空花園
where.en: Sky courses (1-3 Cloud Bridges, 1-6 Sky Gym), Frostpeak Snowfields, Skyreach Peak, Eagle's Eyrie, Sky Garden

where.zh: 1-F 石頭堡壘、熔岩城、餘燼火山、幽靈古宅
where.en: 1-F Stone Fortress, Lava Castle, Mount Ember, the Haunted Manor

where.zh: 水中與海域（1-W 海底灣、珊瑚海岸、南方群島、深淵大洋、人魚洞窟、1-D 深海溝），以及游泳時
where.en: Underwater and seas (1-W Coral Bay, Coral Coast, Southern Isles, Abyssal Sea, Mermaid Grotto, 1-D Deep Trench), and whenever swimming

harness.notes: js/audio.js exports class Sound (ES module). start() creates the AudioContext and a setInterval(50 ms) look-ahead sequencer; setSong(name) selects the song (32 eighth-notes per loop, loop = 960/bpm s). musicOn defaults true; no localStorage read.

notes: Each song is a short 32-step chiptune loop (6-10 s) that repeats; renderSec clamped to the 30 s minimum. 'castle' is an alias of 'fort' in the code.
